notes:
Changed:
- Super Live Stream: the header now matches every other tool (title on the left, ? guide on the right), with one toolbar above the table — search and Delete All on the left (Delete All removes the threads the search shows), Start All / Stop All / Add Thread on the right.
- Delete All in Super Live Stream and Basic Live Stream now has the same bordered style as the buttons next to it, with red text so it doesn't look like Stop All.

Fixed:
- Long file lists (most visible in Concat Videos) no longer spill out of the table's frame — the list scrolls inside it. This applies to every batch tool's table.
- Button labels no longer break onto two lines in a crowded row (e.g. "Chạy tất / cả" in Super Live Stream); the buttons move to a second line instead when the window is narrow.
